label: Matched history transport
title: Rule 62 and Rule 110 need similar history for different reasons
summary: At fresh widths 16 and 18, every nonzero Rule-110 predictive repair is exactly determined by the current predictive label plus current centered Groovy field. Rule 62, despite nearly matching Rule 110 in predictive-compression scaling, has exact early repair counterexamples at both widths.
takeaway: Matching the amount of required history does not match its causal role: Rule 110's repairs are fully coupled to situated change in this test, while Rule 62 needs additional context.
